Corsican

[edit]
Corsican Wikipedia has an article on:
fiore
Wikipedia co

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • fiori

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin flōrem. Compare Italian fiore.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈfjo.re/, /ˈjo.re/
  • Hyphenation: fio‧re

Noun

[edit]

fiore m (plural fiori)

  1. flower

Related terms

[edit]
  • fiuriscia
  • fiurì

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin flōrem.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈfjo.re/
  • Audio (un fiore):(file)
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ore
  • Hyphenation: fió‧re

Noun

[edit]

fiore m (plural fiori, diminutive fiorellìno or (poetic) fiorìno or fioricìno or (archaic) fiorèllo or fiorétto, augmentative fioróne, pejorative fioràccio)

  1. (also figurative) flower, bloom, blossom
  2. surface
    a fior d'acqua ― just below the surface of the water
  3. (on playing cards) pl clubs
